left.raw_text: - History of clinically significant medical conditions including: Cardiovascular: Atrial Fibrillation, Ventricular Fibrillation, Significant Coronary Artery Disease. Hepatic: Viral or Autoimmune Hepatitis, Cirrhosis of the Liver, Liver Metabolism Disorders. Renal: Any form of renal impairment. EXPAREL® is cleared by the kidneys, thus any form of renal impairment could lead to an adverse reaction.
